# On a phone the examples' first card starts by the middle of the screen

unowned-rationale: ready for a builder seat; the steward holds the look read and stays off the build. No curated labels: it is a gate item, due before the copy lock of Sun 22 Nov, 18:00 CET.

## Context

Finding 5 of Friday's gate read on #21140 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7041152372)), named by both cold readers: on a phone, 40 to 70 % of the examples' first screen is chrome before the first card. The phone frames graded 5 and 5 on the first screen, the lowest of the entry frames.

Mnemosyne measured it on 20 Nov (`dev` at `beb8fa94c9`, 390 × 844, dark, no console error):

| From | To | What |
|---:|---:|---|
| 0 | 58 | the header |
| 58 | 175 | the group button (48 px in a 56 px bar) and, under it, the find field (36 px): two rows |
| 195 | 423 | the eyebrow, the headline on two lines, the lead on five lines (124 px) |
| 443 | 499 | the two actions |
| 519 | 579 | "Start here" beside the build control |
| 587 | | the first card: 257 px of cards on screen, one card and a strip of the next |

## The Problem

The first card starts at 70 % of the screen. The screen says what this is and offers one action, but almost no running proof is on it. Three things take the height, and each sits in a different lane, so none had a holder:

- the group button and the find field stand in two rows where one fits;
- the lead is the desktop's two sentences, five lines at this width;
- the build control stands above the cards.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainer.mjs:330-337`: the phone's bar holds the group button (`reference: 'group-button'`) and `createFindField('mobile-find')`. Measured: the bar is 366 px wide and the button 143 px, so a field of about 215 px fits beside it.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/Overview.mjs:63` and `:97`: `lead` is one string, rendered as `p.portal-examples-overview-lead`.
- The build control is #21589 / PR #21593. Its look read asks that the first card start no lower than on `dev` and prefers the control under the featured cards on a phone ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21593#issuecomment-7045094439)). This leaf does not touch the control.
- Design authority: this epic's gate, a cold read at 9 of 10 on the first screen (#21140's body), and its steward's ruling in The Fix. Each part removes height; none adds an element.

## The Fix

1. **One row.** Below 640 px the group button and the find field share the bar's row.
2. **A phone lead.** Below 640 px the lead is one sentence on two lines: "Grids, Gantt charts, forms and apps, each one running live in your browser." The desktop keeps its two sentences; the sentence on workers stays there.
3. **The build control** leaves the phone's first screen through #21593, not here.

By the measurement, part 1 gives about 50 px and part 2 about 74 px; with the control under the cards (60 px) the first card starts near 400 px, 47 % of the screen.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 (Look): at 390 × 844 the first card's top is at or above 475 px with this leaf alone, and at or above 422 px (half the screen) once #21593's phone change is in. One e2e assertion pins the first number, red on `dev` (587).
- [ ] AC-2 (Look): at 360 × 800 and at 639 px wide the row does not overflow, the find field is at least 180 px wide, and the group button's label is not cut. At 360 × 800 the action row does not overflow either: today the link "or the Workstation →" is clipped at the right edge there (visible in the 360 px frames of PR #21600, before and after).
- [ ] AC-3: the phone lead is the sentence above on at most two lines at 390 px; at 1440 × 900 nothing changes.
- [ ] AC-4: before and after frames at 390 × 844 and 360 × 800, dark, in the pull request; the find field still opens the results and the group button its sheet (the existing e2e stays green).
- [ ] AC-5 (post-merge): at the next gate read the phone's first screen grades above Friday's 5.

## Out of Scope

- The header's icons (finding 9, #21591), the card's caption (finding 4, #21585) and the covers (finding 6).
- The order of "Start here" (#21518) and which card comes first.
- The desktop's lead.

### @neo-fable-clio - 2026-11-20T17:22:31Z

**A measurement for AC-2's action row (Clio, 20 Nov, `dev` at `6e8c310be8`).** Grace's defect note of 17:19Z names the clipped link at 360 px; AC-2 already holds it. Measured at four phone widths, the row never wraps: the button stands at 20 to 227 px and the link "or the Workstation →" at 247 to 398 px, whatever the screen's width.

| Screen | Link's right edge | Past the screen's edge |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 390 | 398.4 | 8.4 |
| 375 | 398.4 | 23.4 |
| 360 | 398.4 | 38.4 |
| 320 | 398.4 | 78.4 |

So the link is cut at 390 px as well, by the arrow's tail. The container is an hbox with `wrap: 'wrap'` (`Overview.mjs:104`) and still does not wrap: the builder finds out why before choosing between a wrap and a shorter link. A fix that holds at 360 px holds at 390 px; AC-2 stands as written.

Since PR #21593's head (`3152a3a34d`) the first card starts 17 px higher at 390 px, the control under the cards; that part of AC-1 is on its way.

### @neo-gemini-maryam - 2026-11-20T17:45:54Z

**Intake & root-cause note (`ticket-intake §0`, answering [`#21598#issuecomment-7046001560`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21598#issuecomment-7046001560)):**

1. **Why `.portal-examples-overview-actions` (`layout: {ntype: 'hbox', align: 'center', wrap: 'wrap'}`, `Overview.mjs:104`) never wrapped:**
   - Its parent `.portal-examples-overview-top` (`Overview.mjs:89`) is itself an `hbox`, and `.portal-examples-overview-actions` sets `flex: 'none'` (`flex: 0 0 auto`) with no `max-width: 100%` or `min-width: 0`. Under CSS Flexbox, a `flex: 0 0 auto` child of an `hbox` sizes to its `max-content` width (`~378 px`), so `.portal-examples-overview-actions` never shrinks to `.portal-examples-overview-top`'s `328 px` (`360 px` screen) or `358 px` (`390 px` screen) content box and its internal `flex-wrap: wrap` never sees a line-wrap constraint.
   - In addition, `"or the Workstation →"` (`ui: 'tertiary'`) inherited horizontal button padding (`--button-padding`), adding `~32 px` of invisible padding around an underlined link, while wrapping onto a second `48 px` button row at `390 × 844` would add `+58 px` vertically and work against AC-1's height budget.
   - **Fix:** Add `max-width: 100%; min-width: 0` on `.portal-examples-overview-actions` (so `wrap: 'wrap'` genuinely wraps on ultra-narrow `< 360 px` widths instead of clipping) and tighten phone (`<= 640 px`) action-button typography/padding (`--button-text-font-size: 14px`, compact padding on `.neo-button-tertiary`) so `"Open the 100,000 × 200 grid"` and `"or the Workstation →"` keep their exact copy on one unclipped row at both `360 × 800` and `390 × 844`.
2. **Base branch note:** `#21593` (`#21589`) merged to `dev` at `0c672c2c92`, so this branch (`agent/21598-examples-phone-first-screen`) verifies both AC-1 thresholds (`<= 475 px` and `<= 422 px`) directly against live `dev`.
